subject.title: feat(grok): handle ask_user_question and exit_plan_mode client extensions

question: Should `acpx` expose stable Grok-specific `onAskUserQuestion` and `onExitPlanMode` callbacks in its public embedding API, rather than supporting only CLI handling or a future generic extension hook?
rationale: The callbacks are new public API surface for one vendor and the vision requires deliberate decisions about agent-specific conventions and long-term compatibility contracts.

options.title: Adopt the narrow callbacks
options.body: Approve the two callbacks as stable Grok interoperability support, with matching Grok documentation and compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Keep CLI support only
options.body: Handle the methods in the CLI but remove the exported callback API until a broader embedding use case is defined.

options.title: Design a generic extension hook first
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define a generic client-extension callback model that avoids accumulating vendor-specific public options.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow callbacks
recommendation.body: Approve the two callbacks as stable Grok interoperability support, with matching Grok documentation and compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main ACP feature owner should make the public API direction decision, but the available history evidence did not identify an individual reliably.
